<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Vibe Visual AI — Maryna Chumak</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@400;700;900&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;background:#eeecea;color:#111;overflow-x:hidden;}
:root{--pink:#ff1f8e;--bg:#eeecea;}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;width:100%;z-index:300;padding:16px 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;transition:.3s;}
nav.scrolled{background:rgba(238,236,234,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
.nav-logo{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:white;}
.nav-logo span{color:var(–pink);}
nav.scrolled .nav-logo{color:#111;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;}
.nav-links a{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);text-decoration:none;transition:.2s;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(–pink);}
nav.scrolled .nav-links a{color:#111;}
nav.scrolled .nav-links a:hover{color:var(–pink);}
.nav-btn{background:var(–pink);color:white!important;padding:11px 26px;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none!important;transition:.2s;}
.nav-btn:hover{opacity:.85!important;transform:scale(1.03);}

/* HERO — FULLSCREEN PHOTO */
.hero{
position:relative;
min-height:100vh;
display:flex;
align-items:flex-end;
overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-bg{
position:absolute;inset:0;
background-size:cover;
background-position:center top;
z-index:0;
}
.hero-overlay{
position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
background:linear-gradient(
to bottom,
rgba(0,0,0,.15) 0%,
rgba(0,0,0,.05) 30%,
rgba(0,0,0,.3) 60%,
rgba(0,0,0,.75) 100%
);
}
.hero-content{
position:relative;z-index:2;
width:100%;
padding:0 56px 70px;
display:flex;
align-items:flex-end;
justify-content:space-between;
gap:40px;
}
@media(max-width:768px){
.hero-content{padding:0 20px 50px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;}
}
.hero-left{max-width:600px;}
.hero-tag{
display:inline-block;background:var(–pink);color:white;
font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;
letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
padding:7px 18px;border-radius:50px;margin-bottom:22px;
}
.hero-h1{
font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;
font-size:clamp(32px,5.5vw,72px);
font-weight:900;line-height:1.0;
letter-spacing:-1.5px;color:white;
margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero-h1 .pk{color:var(–pink);}
.hero-h1 .ol{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px white;}
.hero-p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);max-width:500px;margin-bottom:30px;}
.hero-p strong{color:white;}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn-pink{background:var(–pink);color:white;padding:15px 34px;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;transition:.25s;display:inline-block;}
.btn-pink:hover{opacity:.85;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(255,31,142,.4);}
.btn-white{border:2px solid white;color:white;padding:15px 34px;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;transition:.25s;display:inline-block;}
.btn-white:hover{background:white;color:#111;}
.hero-right{flex-shrink:0;}
.hero-nums{display:flex;gap:28px;}
.hn{text-align:center;}
.hn-n{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:30px;font-weight:900;color:var(–pink);}
.hn-l{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:3px;}

/* SCROLL HINT */
.scroll-hint{
position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;
animation:bounce 2s infinite;
}
.scroll-hint span{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;}
.scroll-hint svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px);}}

/* TICKER */
.ticker{background:#111;padding:15px 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;}
.ticker-inner{display:inline-block;animation:tick 22s linear infinite;}
.ti{display:inline-block;font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:white;padding:0 26px;}
.ti .d{color:var(–pink);}
@keyframes tick{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* SECTIONS */
.sec{padding:90px 56px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;}
@media(max-width:768px){.sec{padding:56px 20px;}}
.sl{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#888;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.sl::before{content:’’;width:18px;height:1px;background:#888;}
.st{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,46px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:44px;}
.st .pk{color:var(–pink);}
.st .it{font-style:italic;font-family:‘Manrope’,sans-serif;font-weight:300;color:var(–pink);}

/* WHO */
.who-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px;}
.who-card{background:white;border-radius:18px;padding:24px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);display:flex;gap:14px;transition:.25s;}
.who-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-color:var(–pink);}
.wn{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:#eee;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;transition:.25s;}
.who-card:hover .wn{color:var(–pink);}
.wt{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px;}
.wd{font-size:12px;color:#666;line-height:1.6;}

/* PHOTO BANNER SECTIONS — фото на весь фон */
.pf{position:relative;height:65vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;}
.pf-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center top;}
.pf-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
.pf-c{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:0 24px;max-width:820px;}
.pf-t{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,50px);font-weight:900;color:white;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:24px;}
.pf-t .pk{color:var(–pink);}
.pf-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:26px;letter-spacing:.5px;}

/* GLASS CARD over photo */
.pg{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:560px;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.pg-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center top;filter:brightness(.38);}
.pg-c{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:56px;}
@media(max-width:768px){.pg-c{padding:36px 20px;}}
.gc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:24px;padding:36px 40px;max-width:520px;color:white;}
.gcl{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–pink);margin-bottom:12px;}
.gct{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(19px,2.8vw,30px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:16px;}
.gcp{font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);}
.gcp strong{color:white;}

/* PROGRAM */
.prog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px;}
.pc{background:white;border-radius:18px;padding:26px 22px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);transition:.25s;}
.pc:hover{border-color:var(–pink);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.pe{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.pt{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}
.pd{font-size:13px;color:#666;line-height:1.7;}

/* RESULTS */
.rl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.rr{background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-left:4px solid transparent;transition:.2s;}
.rr:hover{border-left-color:var(–pink);}
.ri{font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;}
.rt{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;}
.rt span{color:var(–pink);font-weight:700;}

/* PHOTO STRIP — 4 фото в ряд як фони */
.strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
@media(max-width:768px){.strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
.strip-item{
aspect-ratio:3/4;
background-size:cover;background-position:center top;
position:relative;overflow:hidden;
transition:.4s;
}
.strip-item:hover{transform:scale(1.02);z-index:2;}
.strip-item-ov{
position:absolute;inset:0;
background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 0%,transparent 50%);
opacity:0;transition:.3s;
}
.strip-item:hover .strip-item-ov{opacity:1;}

/* REVIEWS */
.rev-bg{background:#111;padding:90px 0;}
.rev-in{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 56px;}
@media(max-width:768px){.rev-in{padding:0 20px;}}
.rev-sl{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#444;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.rev-sl::before{content:’’;width:18px;height:1px;background:#444;}
.scr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:44px;}
.scr-card{background:white;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:.3s;}
.scr-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(255,31,142,.25);}
.scr-card img{width:100%;display:block;}
.scr-cap{padding:12px 14px;background:#1a1a1a;}
.scr-nm{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:white;}
.scr-sb{font-size:11px;color:var(–pink);margin-top:2px;}
.rev-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:14px;}
.rc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;transition:.3s;}
.rc:hover{border-color:rgba(255,31,142,.4);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.rc.big{grid-column:span 2;background:rgba(255,31,142,.07);border-color:rgba(255,31,142,.2);}
@media(max-width:680px){.rc.big{grid-column:span 1;}}
.rs{color:#ffb800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:11px;}
.rq{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:46px;color:rgba(255,31,142,.15);line-height:.4;margin-bottom:12px;}
.rtx{font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);}
.rtx strong{color:var(–pink);}
.rau{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);}
.rav{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(–pink),#ff7ecf);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:white;flex-shrink:0;}
.rnm{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:white;}
.rsb{font-size:11px;color:#555;}

/* PRICING */
.pr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:44px;}
.prcard{background:white;border-radius:22px;padding:34px 28px;border:2px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);position:relative;transition:.3s;}
.prcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.prcard.hot{border-color:var(–pink);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff5fa,white);}
.pr-badge{position:absolute;top:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(–pink);color:white;font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;padding:6px 18px;border-radius:50px;white-space:nowrap;}
.pr-em{font-size:38px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.pr-name{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}
.pr-price{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:46px;font-weight:900;color:var(–pink);line-height:1;margin:10px 0 5px;}
.pr-price sup{font-size:19px;vertical-align:top;margin-top:8px;display:inline-block;}
.pr-sub{font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-bottom:20px;}
.pr-list{list-style:none;margin-bottom:26px;}
.pr-list li{padding:8px 0;font-size:13px;color:#444;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;}
.pr-list li::before{content:‘✓’;color:var(–pink);font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;}
.pr-btn{display:block;text-align:center;background:#111;color:white;padding:14px;border-radius:13px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;transition:.25s;}
.prcard.hot .pr-btn{background:var(–pink);}
.pr-btn:hover{opacity:.85;transform:scale(1.02);}

/* ABOUT */
.about-w{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:70vh;}
@media(max-width:768px){.about-w{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.ab-ph{overflow:hidden;min-height:480px;background-size:cover;background-position:center top;}
.ab-side{background:var(–bg);padding:60px 52px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
@media(max-width:768px){.ab-side{padding:40px 20px;}}
.ab-role{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–pink);margin-bottom:12px;}
.ab-name{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(26px,3.8vw,48px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.0;margin-bottom:22px;}
.ab-p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#555;margin-bottom:12px;}
.ab-p strong{color:#111;}
.ab-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;}
.chip{background:white;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;}

/* TOOLS */
.tools-s{background:white;padding:80px 56px;}
.tools-in{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;}
.tt-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:38px;}
.tt{background:var(–bg);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:.2s;cursor:default;}
.tt:hover{background:var(–pink);color:white;border-color:var(–pink);transform:scale(1.05);}
@media(max-width:768px){.tools-s{padding:56px 20px;}}

/* CTA */
.cta{background:#111;padding:110px 40px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cta-gl{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:700px;height:500px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,31,142,.18) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;}
.cta-in{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;}
.cta-ey{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–pink);margin-bottom:20px;}
.cta-h{font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(34px,7vw,72px);font-weight:900;color:white;line-height:1.0;margin-bottom:20px;letter-spacing:-1.5px;}
.cta-h .pk{color:var(–pink);display:block;}
.cta-sub{font-size:17px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:38px;}
.cta-bts{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.cta-big{display:inline-block;background:var(–pink);color:white;padding:19px 56px;border-radius:50px;font-family:‘Unbounded’,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-decoration:none;transition:.3s;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(255,31,142,.4);}
.cta-big:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 56px rgba(255,31,142,.6);}
.cta-tg{background:#2AABEE;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(42,171,238,.4);}
.cta-tg:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 56px rgba(42,171,238,.6);}
.cta-note{margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);letter-spacing:1px;}

footer{background:#0a0a0a;padding:22px 40px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#333;letter-spacing:.5px;}
footer a{color:var(–pink);text-decoration:none;}

.r{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:all .7s ease;}
.r.on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.d1{transition-delay:.1s}.d2{transition-delay:.2s}.d3{transition-delay:.3s}
@media(max-width:768px){nav{padding:14px 20px;}.nav-links a:not(.nav-btn){display:none;}.cta{padding:72px 20px;}}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<nav id="navbar">
  <div class="nav-logo">VIBE <span>VISUAL</span> AI</div>
  <div class="nav-links">
    <a href="#reviews">Відгуки</a>
    <a href="#pricing">Ціни</a>
    <a href="https://www.instagram.com/_marina_chumak_/" target="_blank">Instagram</a>
    <a href="#cta" class="nav-btn">Записатися →</a>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO — ПОВНОЕКРАННЕ ФОТО -->

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');"></div>
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-content">
    <div class="hero-left">
      <div class="hero-tag">AI Creator · Beauty Expert 14 років · Barcelona 🇪🇸🇺🇦</div>
      <h1 class="hero-h1">
        <span>VIBE</span>
        <span class="pk">VISUAL AI</span>
        <span class="ol">CREATOR</span>
      </h1>
      <p class="hero-p">
        <strong>Марина Чумак</strong> — Б'юті-майстер з 14-річним досвідом, Креативний директор та AI Visual Creator.<br>
        Поринь зі мною у світ фантастики та візуалу на будь-яку фантазію ✨
      </p>
      <div class="hero-btns">
        <a href="#pricing" class="btn-pink">Записатися на курс</a>
        <a href="#reviews" class="btn-white">Читати відгуки</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-right">
      <div class="hero-nums">
        <div class="hn"><div class="hn-n">500+</div><div class="hn-l">випускниць</div></div>
        <div class="hn"><div class="hn-n">€150</div><div class="hn-l">онлайн-курс</div></div>
        <div class="hn"><div class="hn-n">1 день</div><div class="hn-l">до результату</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="scroll-hint">
    <span>scroll</span>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12l7 7 7-7"/></svg>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- TICKER -->

<div class="ticker">
  <div class="ticker-inner">
    <span class="ti">AI Фотосесії <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Нейровідео <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Промпт-інжиніринг <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Монетизація <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Сертифікат AI Creator <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Vibe Visual AI <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Barcelona <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Maryna Chumak <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">14 років досвіду <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">AI Фотосесії <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Нейровідео <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Промпт-інжиніринг <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Монетизація <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Сертифікат AI Creator <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Vibe Visual AI <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Barcelona <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">Maryna Chumak <span class="d">✦</span></span>
    <span class="ti">14 років досвіду <span class="d">✦</span></span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- FOR WHOM -->

<div class="sec">
  <div class="r"><div class="sl">Для кого</div>

<script>
// Nav scroll effect
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  document.getElementById('navbar').classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>80);
});
// Reveal
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(e=>{e.forEach(el=>{if(el.isIntersecting)el.target.classList.add('on');});},{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.r').forEach(r=>obs.observe(r));
// Smooth scroll
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>{
  a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
    if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  });
});
</script>
